buggy_html:
Create your account

Create Account
spec: The registration form must be fully operable via keyboard and accessible to screen reader users. The primary 'Create Account' action must be reachable and activatable with Tab + Enter/Space. All buttons must have descriptive accessible names. Text must meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1.
severity_reason: The primary action 'Create Account' is a <div>, not a <button> — it is completely inaccessible by keyboard. Keyboard users have no way to submit the registration form, which blocks the core user flow entirely.
red_herrings: The form fields use both label and placeholder — this is correct; placeholder is supplementary
Inline CSS styling on the card — a code style issue, not an accessibility or functional bug

model_report.title: Primary CTA inaccessible via keyboard — <div> used instead of <button>
model_report.steps:
1. Open the page
2. Press Tab to navigate through interactive elements
3. Observe which elements receive focus
4. Attempt to activate 'Create Account' using Enter or Space
model_report.expected: Tab order includes the 'Create Account' button; pressing Enter or Space while focused on it triggers account creation
model_report.actual:
Bug 1 [CRITICAL]: 'Create Account' is a <div class='btn-primary'> — not a native button or any interactive element. It is skipped entirely by Tab navigation. Keyboard users cannot register.

Bug 2 [MAJOR]: The close button ✕ is a <button> but has no aria-label. Screen readers announce 'button' with no context about its purpose.

Bug 3 [MAJOR]: 'Cancel' button has text colour #d0d0d0 on white background — contrast ratio ≈ 1.6:1 (required: 4.5:1). The button label is effectively invisible for users with low vision.
